units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 5:7">Nidd. V, 7</cite> <he>מָשָׁל מָשְׁלוּ וכ׳</he> the scholars introduced metaphors for designating the stages of female puberty.
<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 1:11">Tosef. Ber. I, 11</cite> <he>משלו משל למה וכ׳</he> they made a comparison: what is this to be compared to? To &c.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17b:18">R. Hash. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>אֶמְשׁוֹל לך משל למה וכ׳</he> let me tell thee a parable: what is this like to? To &c.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:15:1">Cant. R. to II, 15</cite> <he>כשחוא מוֹשֵׁל את המלכיות אינו מוֹשְׁלָן אלא באש</he> when one wants to find a simile for hostile governments, one compares them to fire; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מָשׁוּל</he>; f. <he>מְשׁוּלָה</he>; pl. <he>מְשׁוּלִים</he>, <he>מְשׁוּלִין</he>; <he>מְשׁוּלוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Megillah 16a:15">Meg. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>אומה זו מ׳ לעפר ומ׳ וכ׳</he> that nation (Israel) is compared now to dust and now to the stars; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Taanit 7a:9">Taan. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>נִמְשְׁלוּ דברי תורה לאש</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>כאש</he>, <he>באש</he>. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the words of the Law are compared to fire.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:9">Gen. R. s. 41</cite> <he>התורה שנִמְשְׁלָה למים</he> the Law which is compared to water; a. v. fr.
